role.altitude: The controller moves from building the cash forecast, the advice packs and the payroll tie-outs by hand to designing them. They own the forecast drivers, materiality thresholds, tie-out rules and the policy text. Code and small model loops make the first draft, and the controller signs off.
reach: FP&A Analyst: share one driver-based forecast model and stop keeping two cash views in Excel
Payroll Specialist: agree a payroll-to-ledger tie-out that runs on every pay run, not only at month end
Bookkeeper: use the same AFAS bank-matching rules and the queue of unmatched items
Finance Director: get a weekly cash and covenant view instead of a monthly one
skills_to_grow: Specifying deterministic rules and tie-out checks precisely enough for a developer or AI coding tool
Reviewing model-drafted commentary against source numbers, and keeping an audit trail the auditor can rebuild
Driver-based cash forecasting for a seasonal flex workforce
Running a governed policy answer desk: curating sources and watching answer quality
role.ambitious_version: A weekly, driver-based 13-week cash and funding view on the governed data platform. It ties to the bank and AFAS every day. Every Monday it gives the Finance Director a draft funding or deposit recommendation, and it gives site managers a self-service budget and policy desk. The controller spends the freed time on the season plan for flex workers and on the bank and auditor relationships.

tasks.short: Judge cash shortfalls or surpluses, then recommend borrowing, credit-line use or deposits to the Finance Director.

steps.what: Collect bank balances, AR and AP ageing, and payroll and agency payment dates
Roll the 13-week cash forecast forward in Excel
Judge funding need or surplus against seasonal peaks, capex and covenants
Write the funding or investment recommendation memo

loop.input: Forecast tables, scenario results and the controller's notes on the assessment
loop.output: Draft memo with options, numbers and risks
loop.check: Code checks that every number in the text matches the forecast table; the controller edits and signs
loop.stop: One draft plus at most two redrafts; if numbers fail to match, fall back to a table-only template
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template cannot explain why the position changed or weigh the options in plain prose

steps.what: Discuss and agree the recommendation with the Finance Director

tasks.design: A scheduled Python job on a governed data platform pulls Rabobank CAMT.053 statements, AFAS AR/AP ageing and payroll dates, and agency order volumes. It feeds a driver-based 13-week cash forecast in Power BI, with scenarios for the flex worker season. A bounded model step drafts the funding memo from the approved figures, and the controller decides and signs.
tasks.previous_blocker: Cash data sat in three places (bank, AFAS, agency portals), so the forecast was rebuilt by hand in Excel each week, and nobody had time to code the links.
tasks.enabler_now: AI coding makes the AFAS API and CAMT.053 connectors and the forecast model a few days of work. Models can draft a memo whose numbers code can check.
tasks.still_hard: Forecasting flex worker volumes and customer payment behaviour. Covenant and bank terms need a person who knows the facility agreement. Investment and borrowing choices carry real financial risk.
tasks.human_edge: Weighing liquidity risk against return, and knowing what the bank and the Finance Director will accept, needs judgement and relationships that the data does not hold.

ambition.what: A weekly funding and surplus decision instead of an ad-hoc monthly look

tasks.altitude: The controller stops building the forecast and reviews a ready one every Monday. They gain the right to set forecast drivers and buffer thresholds.

reach.learn: Use the same drivers for flex worker cost and DSO so cash and P&L forecasts agree
Which customers' payment delays move the cash low point most

evidence.claim: AFAS bank matching uses fixed rules on reference, IBAN and invoice number, so statement data is structured for deterministic use
Cash allocation needs mandatory human review and approval with timestamped logs
Funding and planning advice suits a copilot at autonomy level 2; cash allocation stays human
Rabobank offers CAMT.053 statement exports usable by a scheduled job

assumptions: Noordhaven has a credit facility and deposit options with Rabobank
A governed data platform or Azure environment is available, or can be set up
The forecast is weekly today and built in Excel
unknowns: Covenant terms and how often the bank asks for reports
Whether the agency portals offer exports or APIs
Whether the treasury policy sets limits for deposits and counterparties
research_questions: How far off was the current Excel forecast from actual cash over the last 26 weeks?
Can AFAS Profit connectors deliver AR/AP ageing and payroll payment dates daily without manual export?
Do the three agency portals expose order and invoice data by API or file?
Would the Finance Director act on a weekly recommendation, or is funding decided only quarterly?

tasks.short: Advise the management team on financial objectives, policies and actions, using actuals, forecasts and analysis.

steps.what: Gather actuals, KPIs and forecast from Power BI and AFAS
Analyse variances and trends per site and value stream in Excel

loop.input: Variance table computed by code above materiality thresholds, plus AFAS journal descriptions
loop.check: Each comment must cite its driver lines; code rejects comments that name amounts not in the table
loop.stop: One pass per line; lines without a clear driver are marked 'ask owner' for the controller
loop.why_not_simpler: Variance amounts are deterministic, but explaining them needs reading free-text journal descriptions

steps.what: Build the advice pack with options, effects and a recommendation

loop.input: Approved variance analysis, scenario outputs and the controller's position
loop.output: Draft slides and a one-page summary
loop.check: Numbers are filled from the model, not typed; the controller rewrites the recommendation
loop.stop: One draft; the controller edits it by hand
loop.why_not_simpler: The structure is fixed, but the narrative changes every cycle

steps.what: Present and discuss with the management team
Follow up agreed actions by mail

tasks.design: Extend the nightly AFAS extract in Power BI with a management view per site and value stream, with materiality thresholds. A Python job computes variances, and a bounded model step drafts flux comments and a slide pack template that the controller edits. Agreed actions go to a SharePoint list with Teams reminders.
tasks.previous_blocker: Variance commentary needs reading journal text and knowing the business, so it stayed manual, and the pack was rebuilt in PowerPoint each month.
tasks.enabler_now: Models now draft flux commentary well enough to review, and code can check that every number in the text matches the source table.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding what management should do, and framing it for each director. Dutch GAAP and site-specific context are untested in benchmarks.
tasks.human_edge: The controller reads the room, knows each director's priorities and takes responsibility for the advice. Trust in the forecast is built in person.

ambition.what: A short monthly finance brief per site manager in Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo

tasks.altitude: Less time on making the pack, more on the advice itself. The controller gains the right to set materiality thresholds and the standard pack structure.

reach.learn: Feed forecast deltas into the same variance view so advice and forecast agree
How flex worker and absence costs drive site results

evidence.claim: Products draft accruals and close work, and people approve it (review and approve, retain for audit)
Accountants using AI closed the month 7.5 days faster across 79 small and mid-sized firms
On the full close the bottleneck is accounting judgement, not retrieval
An estimate whose prompt and output sit in a personal account cannot be rebuilt by the auditor

assumptions: The management pack is monthly and built in PowerPoint from Power BI and Excel
Journal descriptions in AFAS are filled in well enough to explain variances
unknowns: What the management team actually reads and decides from the pack
Which model platform IT allows for confidential financial data
research_questions: What share of draft flux comments does the controller accept with light edits over three months?
Are AFAS journal descriptions rich enough to explain the main variances?
Would site managers use a monthly per-site brief, and would it change their decisions?

tasks.short: Check payroll deductions from AFAS payroll, reconcile them to the ledger, approve the payments and returns.

steps.what: Receive the payroll journal, wage tax return and pension figures from payroll
Reconcile deductions to ledger, wage tax return, pension invoice and bank
Investigate differences with the payroll specialist
Approve the wage tax and pension payments and the tax return
Post holiday pay, year-end bonus and pension accruals

tasks.design: AFAS payroll keeps computing the deductions. A scheduled Python job on the data platform ties each pay run's journal to the GL, wage tax return, pension fund invoice and Rabobank debits, and posts a breaks list to the payroll specialist in Teams. Accruals for holiday pay and the year-end bonus are generated from rules in AFAS and approved by the controller; payments stay behind the controller's signature.
tasks.previous_blocker: The payroll journal, wage tax return and pension invoice come from different sources and formats, so the tie-out stayed an Excel job each month.
tasks.enabler_now: AI coding makes the reconciliation script and AFAS connectors cheap to build. The rules are fixed, so no model is needed at run time.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining breaks such as retro CAO changes, sick-pay corrections and leavers. Special-category data under AVG/GDPR needs strict access limits.
tasks.human_edge: Signing off payments to the tax office and pension fund is an accountable act. Untangling odd cases with payroll needs knowledge of the CAO and context.

ambition.what: Tie out every pay run (weekly flex and monthly staff) instead of once at month end

tasks.altitude: The controller reviews a breaks list rather than building the reconciliation. They gain the right to set tolerance thresholds for the tie-out.

reach.learn: Get breaks the same day and fix them before the return is filed
Payroll accruals arrive tied out, with no late adjustments

evidence.claim: The pattern is that the tie-out decides: nothing posts until the figures tie to zero
Payroll deductions belong to deterministic software with a tie-out gate, autonomy 3
AFAS Profit payroll computes wage tax and pension deductions inside the standard product

assumptions: Payroll is run in AFAS Profit by the payroll specialist
The controller reviews and approves rather than computes deductions
Pension is run by a sector fund that sends monthly invoices
unknowns: Whether the works council must consent under WOR article 27 to a new tool processing payroll data
Which pension fund and invoice format apply
How often reconciliation breaks occur today
research_questions: How many breaks per month does today's tie-out find, and how many are timing differences?
Can the pension invoice and wage tax return be read as structured files, or only as PDFs?
Does the works council see this as a change to personnel data processing that needs consent?

tasks.short: Answer site managers' and departments' questions on budget and accounting policies, and keep the procedures current.

steps.what: Receive and answer policy questions from budget holders by mail and Teams

loop.input: The question plus retrieved passages from the finance policies and procedures on SharePoint
loop.output: Draft answer quoting the policy passage it relies on
loop.check: The answer must cite a passage; the controller approves before it is sent; questions with no source go to the controller
loop.stop: One retrieval and one draft; a low retrieval score routes the question straight to the controller
loop.why_not_simpler: Questions arrive in free text and use site jargon, so FAQ keyword matching misses most of them

steps.what: Look up budget status and spend for the asking unit
Advise managers in meetings on budget control and spend decisions
Update policies and procedures on SharePoint

loop.input: Current policy text and the logged questions the policy did not answer
loop.check: The controller accepts or rejects each change; the Finance Director approves publication
loop.why_not_simpler: Finding gaps from free-text questions needs reading; the edit itself stays a human decision

steps.what: Explain changes to budget holders

tasks.design: A Teams answer desk over the finance policies on SharePoint drafts cited answers, which the controller approves at first and later releases by question type. A Power BI budget-holder view with row-level security per site replaces manual lookups. Logged questions feed a quarterly redline of the policies.
tasks.previous_blocker: Policies sat in long Word files that managers did not read, and search could not handle free-text questions, so everything went to the controller by mail.
tasks.enabler_now: Retrieval with citations over a small, curated document set is now reliable enough to draft answers for review. Power BI row-level security is standard.
tasks.still_hard: Keeping policies current and consistent. Grey-area questions on spend approval need judgement. Managers may still prefer to call.
tasks.human_edge: Persuading a site manager to change spending, and judging exceptions to policy, need trust and authority.

ambition.what: Shift leaders and team leads at the three sites who order supplies but never get finance guidance today

tasks.altitude: Fewer repeat questions in the inbox; more time in budget meetings with sites. The controller gains a question log showing where policy fails.

reach.task: Handle questions on invoices and purchase approvals
reach.learn: Point recurring supplier and approval questions to the same desk

reach.task: Advise managers on flex worker hiring
reach.learn: Give one consistent answer on budget for flex workers

evidence.claim: Controls and standards work suits a copilot at autonomy 2, with model digests of standard changes
Prompt and output must sit in a governed system, not a personal account, so answers can be audited
Power BI supports row-level security per site for budget views

assumptions: Finance policies and procedures are stored on SharePoint
unknowns: How many policy questions per month reach the controller, and from whom
Whether the policies are current enough to answer from
Whether IT allows a model-based assistant in Teams for internal data
research_questions: What share of last quarter's questions could be answered from current policy text?
After a pilot at one site, how many drafted answers did the controller send without change?
Do site managers use a self-service budget view when it is offered?
